body:
I just finished reading A New Kind of Christianity and found it quite inspiring. After reading it again and going over your notes in the back of the book, I plan to teach it to a class at my church. I cannot thank you enough for the ways you have provoked my thinking over the years.

You and I met briefly in Waco a few years ago when you came to speak after the death of the young pastor … I appreciated your kindness that day and your love and concern for that fellowship of young believers.

Blessings to you. Thanks for being such a clear voice of reason. You are truly making a difference.

 Thanks for these encouraging words. I’m so glad to hear the book has been helpful. I hope the group study stimulates lots of good conversation and insight.
